interpretation: Diversifying the target-law surface forms did not produce a fully portable weight-encoded prior.

Thinking mode matters: the adapter recalled the exact target law under two held-out equation prompts and one semantically equivalent prose prompt, but failed every held-out recall prompt with thinking disabled.
The structured benchmark-JSON recall, labeled-parameter recall, and held-out numerical application remained wrong even with thinking enabled.
The adapter retained ordinary algebra and followed both confirming L_A evidence and decisive conflicting L_B evidence in the familiar benchmark prompt.

At a 4096-token ceiling, the held-out fictional-domain induction trace derived and checked the correct law but truncated before emitting JSON; the same controlled case completed and matched exactly with a 6144-token ceiling.
The evidence therefore does not show loss of controlled exponent reasoning; it shows a verbosity and termination problem plus incomplete portability of direct recall.
The planned 120/160-step continuation was not started because the portable-recall gate remained below its prespecified threshold.
